description: Scientific Proceedings is a clinical and scientific research journal published by the KIMSHEALTH group of hospitals to share the latest clinical insights, therapeutic strategies, and research outcomes across medical and allied health disciplines. The journal primarily features scholarly and clinical work from the KIMSHEALTH network. It aims to promote medical knowledge, improve patient care, inspire innovation, and serve as a platform for clinicians and researchers to communicate their experiences and findings to a broader audience.
highlights: Autologous stem cell transplantation for multiple myeloma
External validation of the Sudbury Vertigo Risk Score in acute vertigo
Optimizing pre-operative echocardiography: An audit of referral appropriateness
Brucella melitensis spondylodiscitis masquerading as enteric fever: Diagnosis by whole-genome shotgun metagenomic sequencing
Unmasking the unusual: Atypical manifestations of gastric carcinoma
Ciguatera fish poisoning: An underrecognized toxicological emergency
Platelet-rich plasma versus hyaluronic acid for knee osteoarthritis: Two decades of evidence
